performance.environment: Production Chromium touch emulation, DPR 3, cloud CPU; physical Safari untested
performance.method: 120 RAF intervals during 40 touch pan moves per mode at Fit and 80%; isolated runs; same WaterVisual scene functions and decoded building/forest images throughout gestures

limitations: Water shading is stylised, not physical depth.
Logical terrain remains cell-based; corner rounding only affects presentation.
Physical Safari hardware is not available.
